title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: global search leaves out the objects of a disabled package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgPKDiLo5gfWzDLyAK6J6UjZ)_
Fixes #35195

Clause-②: yes (narrowing: global search stops returning a disabled package's records, the answer every data route already gives)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches which objects the global search sweep covers, or what a package disable does per door; the change moves a runtime answer, not anything an author writes

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:全局搜索 `GET /api/v1/search` 不再返回已停用包的对象记录;以停用包对象为引用标题目标时,命中只显示原 id,不再借出该记录的标题。
- 为什么改:停用一个包后,数据路由对其记录一律答 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`,搜索却照样返回这些记录的标题和匹配片段,管理员无法如实承诺"停用即隐藏"。
- 风险与回滚:只收窄搜索结果,没有停用包的环境零变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR(一个源文件两行判断)。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-record-reads.ts`(sweep 循环里 `isObjectOfDisabledPackage` 那一行,与 `readReferenceTitles` 里同一判断)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.search-disabled-package-35195.test.ts`、`.changeset/35195-search-disabled-package.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.search-disabled-package-35195.test.ts`,预期 8 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`searchAll` (the body behind `GET /api/v1/search`) walks `registry.getAllObjects()`, which still lists a disabled package's objects: the schema stays resolvable on purpose. Nothing on that path asked whether the object's package was disabled, so the records came back as hits while `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id` answered `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`.

- **The record sweep** now asks `isObjectOfDisabledPackage(registry, name)`, the same optional-called predicate the data plane's `assertObjectRegistered` and the by-name `/meta` reads ask, right beside the exposure decision. Such an object is never queried, never named, never counted in `totalObjects`, and the security service is never asked about it. An explicit `?objects=` naming it answers exactly as one naming no object (a sweep, not a by-name read, so no 404), the same answer an object the exposure decision refuses already gets.
- **Reference titles**: `readReferenceTitles` asks the same predicate of the lookup TARGET, so an enabled object whose `nameField` points into a disabled package keeps the bare id, the answer an unreadable target gives. Without it the disabled record's title text still reached the response.
- **Pages**: no change. The page sweep reads through `getMetaItems({ type: 'page' })`, which already omits a disabled package's items (`isItemOfDisabledPackage` in `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`).

The registry member is not declared on the host type (`MetadataHostEngine.registry` is `any`), so the guard uses the existing optional reader in `protocol-authoring-refusals.ts`: a registry that cannot answer hides nothing.

## Tests

New file `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.search-disabled-package-35195.test.ts`, through the real `searchAll` on the protocol, 8 cases:

- THE PIN: a disabled package's record is not a hit, its object is never read, named or counted, and `canReadObject` is never asked about it; the same for a context-less call; an explicit `objects=` naming it equals the answer for a nonexistent object;
- a disabled package's object as a reference title target lends no title (hit keeps `case_5`);
- CONTROLS: re-enabled, the record is a hit again and the reference title reads through; an enabled object's answer is byte-equal with and without the disable; a registry without `isObjectPackageDisabled` hides nothing.

- Sweep guard deleted via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob e880bb73d891 → b9abfc1b7690): `Tests 3 failed | 5 passed (8)`: THE PIN, the context-less case and the `objects=` case red, title and controls green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Title-target guard deleted (anchor 1 → 0, blob e880bb73d891 → 99290a4a9d50): `Tests 1 failed | 7 passed (8)`: `expected [ [ 'note_1', 'PDF export fails' ] ] to deeply equal [ [ 'note_1', 'case_5' ] ]`. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

The test imports `./protocol.js` relatively (source), so no `dist/` leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `searchAll`'s method docblock in `protocol.ts` (its stated contract) has no paragraph for the disabled-package skip; the reasoning sits at the guard in `protocol-record-reads.ts`. `protocol.ts` was outside this card's file fence, so the docblock was left alone.
- Read-only observation, not measured through a door: `servesExpansionTarget` (`protocol-query-validation.ts`) judges an `$expand` target only by its declared exposure, not by `isObjectPackageDisabled`. Whether a data-route `$expand` into a disabled package's object serves its fields was not measured here.
- `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` cites `protocol.package-disable-enforcement.test.ts`, which does not exist under that name in `packages/metadata-protocol/src`.
